result.topic_en: This is not a Riemann manuscript but a printed antiquarian bookseller's catalogue page (p. 6, 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik') listing natural-science and physics books from Engelhardt to Guillemeau with formats, places, years, bindings and prices.
